content: The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxRatiosPerMainFunction ) or the retu rn ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’.

The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxRatiosPerMainFunction ) or the retu rn ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’.

The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxRatiosPerMainFunction ) or the retu rn ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’.
